source_limitations: Oxford headword pages were directly opened on 2026-11-02. Cambridge CEFR labels are public search-index excerpts only: direct Cambridge publisher pages returned HTTP 403. Oxford TOPIC links such as b1 and c1 are not exact-sense CEFR badges. The Cambridge Learner's Dictionary cabinet result is a different dictionary subproduct from the English headword entry. All interpretations and Myanmar proposals are unapproved AI/editorial research, not independently verified review. No British George/Emma audio listened to, physical iPhone tested, or production deployment performed.

frozen_original.burmese_meaning: အစိမ်းဖြစ်သော၊ မချက်ပြုတ်ရသေးသော
frozen_original.example_sentence: Wash your hands after handling raw chicken.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: food not cooked (Oxford sense 1); natural/unprocessed material is a distinct sense 2

records.evidence_note: Frozen example about raw chicken selects uncooked food (indexed B1), not industrial raw materials (indexed B2). The draft definition combines two different senses.
records.proposed_english_definition: Not cooked, especially when referring to food.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: အစားအစာကို မချက်ပြုတ်ရသေးသော၊ အစိမ်းဖြစ်သော။
records.proposed_original_example: The chef kept the raw fish in a chilled container.

frozen_original.english_definition: To move something to a higher position.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: မြှောက်တင်သည်
frozen_original.example_sentence: Two workers helped lift the heavy crate.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: raise a person or object to a higher position

records.evidence_note: The heavy-crate example is a literal raise/carry action, matching the indexed B1 verb; British noun lift meaning elevator is a different POS and cannot support this card.
records.proposed_english_definition: To move someone or something to a higher position.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: လူ သို့မဟုတ် ပစ္စည်းတစ်ခုကို အပေါ်သို့ မြှောက်တင်သည်။
records.proposed_original_example: Please lift the box onto the lower shelf.

frozen_original.english_definition: A strong feeling of surprise caused by an unexpected event.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ရုတ်တရက် အံ့ဩတုန်လှုပ်မှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: The news came as a shock to everyone.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: noun: strong surprise caused by an unexpected event

records.evidence_note: Frozen 'news came as a shock' is emotional-surprise noun, indexed B1. Indexed B2 shock verb and Oxford medical/electrical topic labels are different senses/POS.
records.proposed_english_definition: A strong feeling of surprise or distress after something unexpected happens.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: မမျှော်လင့်ထားသော ဖြစ်ရပ်ကြောင့် ရုတ်တရက် အံ့အားသင့်တုန်လှုပ်ရခြင်း။
records.proposed_original_example: The sudden cancellation came as a shock to the whole team.

frozen_original.burmese_meaning: တိတ်ဆိတ်မှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: A sudden silence filled the room.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: noun sense 1 uncountable absence of sound, distinct from countable period of silence

records.evidence_note: Frozen definition selects uncountable complete quiet (indexed B1). The indexed B2 label belongs to a countable period of quiet; 'a sudden silence' may be interpreted as an onset/period, so example needs sense adjudication rather than an automatic retier.
records.proposed_english_definition: The state of having no sound or noise.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: အသံမရှိဘဲ တိတ်ဆိတ်နေသော အခြေအနေ။
records.proposed_original_example: After the announcement, the hall fell into complete silence.

frozen_original.english_definition: To repeat or write someone's words exactly.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: စကားကို မူရင်းအတိုင်း ကိုးကားဖော်ပြသည်
frozen_original.example_sentence: The report will quote the expert's statement.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: verb: repeat someone else's exact spoken or written words; commercial price quotation is separate

records.evidence_note: Oxford directly documents exact-words verb and places Literature and writing b1 / Language b1 topic links nearby, but topic labels are NOT an exact-sense CEFR badge. Frozen example is not a commercial price quote. Requires independent CEFR adjudication.
records.proposed_english_definition: To repeat or reproduce another person's exact words.
records.proposed_original_example: The journalist quoted the witness's exact words in her article.

frozen_original.english_definition: To fasten something using string or a similar material.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ကြိုးဖြင့် ချည်သည်
frozen_original.example_sentence: Use a strong rope to tie the boxes together.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: verb: fasten objects with rope/string; separate competition and linking senses

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: tie verb (FASTEN) indexed definition, no CEFR badge observed

records.evidence_note: Oxford confirms literal rope/string fastening, but no direct CEFR badge was observed for this exact sense. Cambridge indexed excerpt shows the sense without a trustworthy level badge. Past form tied and -ing tying require their own pronunciation/exemplar checks.
records.proposed_english_definition: To fasten things together with string or rope.
records.proposed_original_example: Tie the parcel securely with string before posting it.

frozen_original.english_definition: A piece of furniture with doors or drawers for storage.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ပစ္စည်းသိုလှောင်ရန် ဗီရို
frozen_original.example_sentence: The medicine cabinet is above the sink.

oxford_direct.observed_sense: furniture for storing/showing things, distinct from government Cabinet

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: cabinet noun (furniture with shelves or drawers)

records.evidence_note: Cambridge Learner's Dictionary indexed furniture entry is B2, consistent with frozen furniture sense. Oxford directly labels furniture under Houses and homes c1 TOPIC and government under Politics c1 TOPIC; those are not direct CEFR badges and must not be used to overrule indexed Cambridge B2.
records.proposed_english_definition: A cupboard or piece of furniture with shelves or drawers for storing things.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: ပစ္စည်းများ သိမ်းဆည်းရန် တံခါး၊ စင် သို့မဟုတ် အံဆွဲပါသော ဗီရို။
records.proposed_original_example: She locked the medicines in the cabinet above the sink.
